name: low height, light weight
source: NAS1291 'NUT, SELF-LOCKING, HEXAGON, LOW HEIGHT, LIGHT WEIGHT', Table I, Rev 16 (2025-03-31), dash 06, A286 CRES 450F finish (key suffix M). height = A MAX, bearingDiameter = OF MIN, ratedUltimateLoad = AXIAL TENSILE STRENGTH LBF MIN / A286 CRES (note /1/: based on 125,000 psi per NASM25027). Rev 16 struck out every steel variant -- the -NN/XNN dash numbers, the entire 160 ksi STEEL strength column, and the steel material/hardness/finish callouts -- so only A286 CRES is seeded here. The A286 450F (C<dash>M), 800F (C<dash>) and 850F (C<dash>J) finish variants share one strength rating; 450F (M) is seeded as canonical. material="A286" (existing library key, 160 ksi Ftu / 93400 psi Fsu MIL-HDBK-5J).
